verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that GitLab documents an official CLI at docs.gitlab.com/editor_extensions/gitlab_cli/, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is only that probe result, with no detail on commands, authentication or AI-agent use. Third-party CLIs in the partner directory (Kilo, Cursor) are not official and are not credited. Missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage, evidence of CLI use in AI or agentic workflows (e.g. driving Duo agents from the terminal), independent or hands-on corroboration.
